query: What narrative or literature-derived experimental stimuli reliably elicit measurable IPEs in physiology or fMRI and how have they been validated?

response.query: What narrative or literature-derived experimental stimuli reliably elicit measurable IPEs in physiology or fMRI and how have they been validated?
response.answer: Narratives like horror stories and emotionally charged films reliably elicit measurable IPEs in physiology or fMRI. These stimuli have been validated through consistent physiological responses and brain activation patterns in studies.

results.title: Too Good to Be True: How TMS Damaged My Brain - Mad In America
results.content: It is highly offensive because someone would post in the group about their life being ruined by TMS or another person would say I am thinking about trying TMS and I want to hear what people here think the risks are, and the bots would always post something like – TMS worked for me, I have been feeling great for 6 months since – or something, you see at first I thought maybe they were honest but after seeing them over and over again with similar syntax and diction every time you see the pattern. So I get to live my life as a mental patient (and have my family destroyed and everything I ever worked for removed from me unlawfully) because they don’t like reality and deny me my human right to not be tortured and kidnapped should a bus driver I had a disagreement with decides to refer me for mental health treatment after ‘spiking’ me with date rape drugs.
